The three SECURITY CONDITIONS attached to the 2026-09-05 reseed sign-off, authored as ONE migration and deliberately SEPARATE from the reseed so a data seed and a behaviour change are never applied or reverted as one unit. C1 TRANSLATE THE STORAGE-GUARD REFUSAL. hr_companion_grant had no exception handler, so a missing companion:<id> row in hr_unlocks (the b453 destruction class, and production's actual state 2026-08-23 to 2026-08-30) made player_progress_unlock_guard raise 23514 / 'unknown_unlock: companion:<id>' and PostgREST return a 500 - indistinguishable from the server being down, unjournalled, unshowable. Now {ok:false, error:'unknown_unlock:companion:<id>'} plus an hr_rejections row, in TWO layers: LAYER A a pre-check on hr_unlocks placed AFTER the owned-once short-circuit (an owner needs no write, so no refusal is owed) and BEFORE the req_item read (a refusal must cost nothing); LAYER B a handler around the mutation block for the TOCTOU race Layer A cannot close, since nothing locks hr_unlocks and the b453 class IS a concurrent wholesale delete. The handler catches SQLSTATE 23514 AND ONLY the message prefix 'unknown_unlock:' and re-raises everything else, so unlock_wrong_kind / unlock_over_ceiling / unlock_bad_rung / unlock_not_storable / unlock_regressed all still propagate and the trigger remains the backstop rather than being replaced by the translation. Because the req_item consume is INSIDE that subtransaction, a raced refusal rolls the egg back with the grant - an exception block around the insert alone would have left the egg consumed and nothing granted, a player-value loss dressed as a fix. C2 ENFORCE THE whelp req_item. The body read player_inventory for dragon_egg, set v_egg true/false, then granted UNCONDITIONALLY either way - Security: enforce it or delete it, do not leave a fake control in place. It now returns {ok:false, error:'missing_req_item', item:'dragon_egg'} and writes no player value, and the FOR UPDATE row lock moves to the CHECK so the consume cannot race a concurrent spend. MEASURED player-facing consequence: ZERO honest calls are refused today. hr_items has no dragon_egg row (0), player_inventory has no dragon_egg row on any character (0), src/data/items.js has no dragon_egg among its 515 items and no drop table / recipe / shop / quest in src/data/** yields one, and the verb has never successfully run in production (0 companion:% unlock rows, 0 companion_grant ledger rows). dragon_egg is unobtainable CONTENT, not merely unmodelled server-side, so this is the cheapest moment the control will ever be enforced. FORWARD CONDITION, recorded: when dragon_egg becomes obtainable it must become a SERVER-HELD item (an hr_items row plus a server-owned grant path) IN THE SAME BUILD - if the client can hold an egg the server cannot see, every honest hatch answers missing_req_item and accrue.js reconcileCompanions drops the companion on the next reload.
